values.note: Village of Bellaire rates effective May 6, 2026: water/electric $30 a night, full hookup $40; rustic (primitive) sites $20, left out of the base. One rate for everyone (no resident rate stated). Full hookup only for monthly ($755) and seasonal ($5,000) stays. Non-camper dump $10.

fees.source: https://bellairemichigan.com/craven/ ('Campground Rates effective May 6, 2026: Full Hook Up (Water/Electric/ Sewer) - $40 per night* Water/Electric - $30 per night* Rustic Sites - $20 per night*', 'Monthly - $755 per month', 'Seasonal - $5,000 per season', 'Non-Camper Dump Fee - $10 per dump'; 'This webpage last updated on May 6, 2026'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://app.fireflyreservations.com/reserve/property/CravenParkCampground (amenity filters 'Electric Hookup (30 amp)', 'Sewer Hook-Up', 'Water Hook-Up'; classes Full Hook-up, Water/Electric, Rustic/Primitive) + https://bellairemichigan.com/craven/, read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://app.fireflyreservations.com/reserve/property/CravenParkCampground ('Coin Operated Showers') + https://bellairemichigan.com/craven/ ('Non-Camper Dump Fee - $10 per dump'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://bellairemichigan.com/craven/ ('Craven Park Campground is open from April 1st (weather permitting) through October 31st'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Sites 22-25 and 31-35 are first-come only (pay by envelope at the bathhouse); all others are reservation-only, booked online (Firefly) or at the village office, 202 N Bridge St, Mon-Thu 8-4. Same-day campers wanting a reservable site must book it online before setting up. After two weeks campers must leave for a week, except monthly or seasonal stays.

booking.source: https://app.fireflyreservations.com/reserve/property/CravenParkCampground ('Sites #22-25 and #31-35 are first-come first-serve only, all others are by reservation only') + https://bellairemichigan.com/craven/ ('Campers may only stay up to two weeks at a time, and must then vacate the campground for one week'), read 2026-10-22

note: Village of Bellaire campground on Craven Pond, a mile east of downtown; full-hookup, water/electric and rustic sites, a walking loop nearby. Google Maps gives wrong directions: the entrance is at the end of E Broad St where it meets S Derenzy (Fairground) Rd. Camp host at site 30. --Claude
summary: Village page (updated May 6, 2026) + Firefly: W/E $30, full hookup $40 (base 20 -> 30: the $20 rustic sites are primitive), 30-amp, water, sewer, coin showers, dump; open Apr 1 (weather permitting)-Oct 31; reservable on Firefly with first-come sites 22-25 and 31-35; 14-night limit then a week out. Site count (35, derived) not stated by the village; left. Monthly/seasonal full-hookup stays exist ($755 / $5,000) but no seasonal count is given. Dropped booking/season/RV Life text from the note; added the directions caveat.
